Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Ferb, what should we do today? I mean, besides giving Perry a bath. (He and Ferb sniff at Perry)

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Chatters)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (peeking over the fence) What is that wonderful noise? (Camera shows Jefferson County Motor Speedway, where the racing cars qualify for Swamp Oil 500, miles away from the house.) Awesome. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I have got to take a new picture of myself for my blog. I didn't realize mine is already a week old. (She takes a selfie; her new selfie is exactly the same as her old one.) That's better. (She walks off, but snaps back to the garage entrance as she notices the boys working on the car.) What are you doing to Mom's car?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb pop out of the hood.) We tricked it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't even know how to drive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, duh. That's why Ferb built this remote. (Ferb activates the remote which activates the engine.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deeply) Oh, you are so busted. (She exits the garage and starts opening and closing doors throughout the house.) (offscreen; opens door) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, reenters garage with her awkward smile) Um, where's Mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as Ferb slams the engine in place) She's playing bridge at Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro's! (Candace grins, then slips out. Ferb closes the hood.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh, they won't get away with it this time! (She goes to the Garcia-Shapiro household and rings the doorbell. Briefly, she turns her head to face the house, raising her eyebrows sneakly. Vivian comes out.)

Name: Vivian
Dialog: (Fast-paced) Oh, Candace, dear. Bubela, how good to see you. What a coincidence. Do you know your mom is here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (The boys begin testing the car behind her.) Mmm-mmm. Yeah, I do, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro. I need to talk to her if you don't mind.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oy-vey. Look how tall you are now. You must've grown a couple of inches since the last time I've saw you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was last week, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Well your mom's inside, dear. Where are your braces? I thought you were wearing braces.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (playing Bridge) What is it, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you have got to see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Back outside, Car zooms past Phineas and Ferb four times.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. What's the red button for? (Car continues zooming, Ferb pushes the red button on remote.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (The car blasts upward behind her; Linda comes out.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it? What do you want me to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gestures toward the boys) Look!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys! (to Candace) Well, if that's all, I'll just be getting back to the game. (Candace just stands there, speechless and deadpanned. Just after Linda closes the door, the car lands back onto the road.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing we beefed up the suspension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! What else can it do?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Walks up; dreamy look and voice) Hi, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're entering The Swamp Oil 500 today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aren't you gonna need a pit crew?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you know a pit crew?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well... I know a few people who work well together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! You're hired! See you at the track. (To Ferb) Hey Ferb, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons completely unknown, he's purchased a giant airship or blimp, as the kids say. Your mission is to find out why, and if necessary, put a stop to it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Dreamily) Hi, Phineas. I got your pit crew. (Show the Fireside Girls lined up behind Isabella)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! See ya in the pits.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls. We're dealing with a 426 cubic inch, fully-blown V8, with hypo lifters, radical cam, and a limited-slip differential.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Would that be electronically fuel-injected?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?! Phineas?! Phineas!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! I can't hear the cars!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! I didn't know you were a racing fan!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy. (A couple seconds later, she slaps herself) Who, me? Oh, yeah! Yeah, I'm a big fan of those, those uh, uh... that red one is cute!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, that's Billy Ray Digler's car. He's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, he's the best. That Billy Roy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Billy Ray.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Billy Ray. I-I love it when he turns left... and then he turns... left again, and then-

Name: Dave
Dialog: And in the 3rd lane, the newcomers Team Phineas!

Name: Rick
Dialog: Now is it just me, or does he look a little bit young to be behind the wheel of a 700 horse power racing machine?

Name: Dave
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he does.

Name: Rick
Dialog: And look, he's already got his own screaming fans!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen) Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace is rooting for us!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you're on the big screen!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen, slow mo) Phineas!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And your little brother's gonna be on TV!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas--? (sees him being interviewed) On TV? (Stands up) TV! That's it! They are so busted! Can you wait here for a second? (zips off, but comes back) Thanks. (zips off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on her cellphone) What is it, Candace? I'm right in the middle of a 3-No trump.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on a payphone at the race) Turn on the TV!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right. All right, Candace. This better be good. (presses a remote, the TV shows static)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) Well? Well? Do you see it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a second, honey.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Turn on the cable box first.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. All right. (Presses another remote, ejecting a CD) Wait. 'Kay, that's not it. Um, is it this one? No, this is another phone.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I turned on the stereo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cringing) Mom, hurry up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, just a second! (Presses the right remote)

Name: TV Narrator
Dialog: Are you embarrassed about flaking?; Itching?; Peeling?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this is a dandruff commercial. Is there something you're trying to tell me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Are we good to go? (Ferb gives a thumbs up)

Name: Rick
Dialog: And with the race about to start, there's the Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated blimp!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. I'm glad you're here. Actually, I was just getting ready to serve some platypus under glass! You're just in time to witness my latest invention... my Deflate-inator Ray! Which I will demonstrate by deflating all the tires of the Jefferson County Motor Speedway! After which, I will deflate everything in the Tri-State Area! That way, if anyone want's anything flated, they will have to talk to me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you are in big trouble, mister--!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you've got a little...

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (takes picture) Smile! Souvenir picture? Only a dollar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks at her picture. She is burnt and Jeremy is staring confused.) Aah! (shakes herself clean) Wait a second. (Grabs camera, runs off)

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Takes a picture of Phineas driving) Ee-ee-ee-ee... now, I gotcha!

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (Snatches picture) Hey hey, Missy. Two pictures, two bucks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, uh, I've only got a dollar, but uh, I just want the one. You can just tear the other one up, 'kay? (The photographer rips one picture.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rides out on bike) I've got 'em, now! Heeheehee.

Name: Rick
Dialog: And on the fast on the inside lane is Number 42, Team Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Do you think we can get any more power? I mean, I know it's just a battery. But I was thinking

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We should bring Phineas in for a pit stop. (The race car enters the pit stop.) All right, Fireside Girls, let's move, move, move! (The girls work on fixing the car) That helmet looks so manly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hit it, Ferb. (The car takes off) I'm so proud of you girls. And the bow was a nice touch, Gretchen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing) Listen to those fools, as they worship their candy-colored race car man. How about a little demonstration of my deflationary prowess? (Fires laser)

Name: Man #2
Dialog: I got it! (The ray hits the beach ball, which starts hissing. )

Name: Race Car Driver
Dialog: (Tires screeching) Aah! (Tires screeching, rams a sign)

Name: Rick
Dialog: The Team Phineas car is avoiding every obstacle! It's like he can see the whole darn track at once!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Guitar solo)

Name: Racers
Dialog: We're okay! (Car zooms by)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) Well Mom, what do you think of this?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You've...looked better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What do you mean--? (looks at the picture of herself burnt, starts to cringe and screams loud. The camera goes back to the D.E.I. blimp above the Speedway)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Already they fear me, listen to their screams, huh? Imagine the mayhem once my Deflate-inator ray is fully charged. (at the mouse in the machine) Run! Run like the wind, my little indentured rodent. And I will give you some cheese. Heh, I know I had some around here somewhere. (Perry pulls out a briefcase filled with cheeses; Grabs stinky cheese and loads it onto a crossbow.) I think there's some- There used to be some Roquefort in the back here. I don't... (Perry fires the crossbow.; Mouse squeaking) Hmm? (He starts screaming hysterically, and the glass breaks) Agh! Oof! (Laser fires, Blimp deflating) Hmm. I suppose I should've seen that coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) But, Mom, you've gotta believe me! (cuts to her.) Wait a minute. I bet it's still on TV! (runs off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Flatly) That's good, Candace. Go watch a little TV. (Candace turns on the TV)

Name: Dave
Dialog: (the screen shows Phineas winning the race. There is a flash, freeze-frame.) And look at this amazing finish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stammering) Mom, come quick! Come look-look-look-look-look!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right! I'm coming! (stands up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Dave
Dialog: Oh no! A blimp is about to hit the broadcasting tower! Oh, the hu- (The TV goes to static. Candace just sits there standing as Linda enters right on schedule.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah-huh...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (leaving) Deal me back in, Viv.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Looks like we're walking.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mimicking Linda) "Why don't you go back home, Candace?" "I'm busy with my bridge game, Candace?" She has no idea! (echo) (Gasps, then looks behind her to see the garage empty. Crickets chirp in the background, She smiles.) Gotcha.

Name: Candace
Dialog: shifts to Perry and Doofenshmirtz fighting in the car wash.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gets caught in one of the car wash rolling brushes) Ahh-ahh-ahh-ahh-ahh! Aah! (Beeping; Explosion, Perry blasts into space on the car)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Runs up to Vivian's house and repeatedly knocks on the door hard) Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, Candace, hello. I can't believe you grown so much, it's unbelievable--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (Goes to the living room) Mom, you've gotta see this! It's about your car!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (While Candace smiles) All right. (Candace drags her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (literally pushes Linda across the street) Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you're wearing out the heels of my shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Mom?! Look, look! I told you--

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Gasps) But... who did this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not even turning her head) Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You mean... they...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overlapping) Yeah, yeah, yeah! (Nods and laughs chaotically)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overjoyed) They washed my car!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes!! (then, confused) No...what?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's beautiful! (For the rest of the scene, Candace stands completely shocked with her mouth open.) I gotta admit, I thought you were exaggerating a bit, but this is really worth getting excited about!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking in the background, trophy in hand) Hi, Mom, we're home!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys! I saw what you did today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Referring to the race) Yeah? How'd you like it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside; oblivious) I loved it! (cut to her and Candace; The instrumental Rock version of the theme song as a stinger.) Now who wants some snacks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Thanks, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Music pauses; at Candace) Honey, close your mouth. (Iris out on Candace as the stinger finishes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Guitar solo)
